column1: # The windows drawn by DynALisp.Windows.Shots for the docs (Program.cs): the window file, its
# sample values (Samples\), the picture its docs page names, and for a large window of several
# sections the part drawn (a GroupBox header, an x:Name, Type:name for the Type that holds it,
# parts joined with +), one row per section. Paths from the root of the repository. A window
# added or changed gets its row in the same change.
